result.title: Antiphony: A Dual-Process Agent for Deepfake Video Detection with Real-Video Calibration
result.summary: Reliable video deepfake detection requires generalization to unseen generators while limiting false alarms on authentic footage. Although existing detectors capture diverse visual cues, they may produce overconfident errors under generator shift, limiting the reliability of confidence-based fusion. Threshold calibration is further complicated by shifts in authentic capture domains and the lack of future-generator examples. To address these challenges, we present Antiphony, a framework that combines calibrated fusion of four visual experts with selective investigation. Authentic videos serve as a shared reference for score fusion and threshold calibration, enabling threshold updates without target deepfakes. For this expert-fusion stage, we establish finite-sample false-alarm control when the scoring procedure is fixed independently of calibration and authentic samples are exchangeable. To refine decisions near the calibrated threshold, a tool-using multimodal investigator examines these videos and contributes an additional fusion score. We train the investigator on generator-held-out predictions and counterfactual expert outputs, to improve robustness to unreliable expert evidence. Across six benchmark protocols, Antiphony achieves a mean benchmark score of 88.3%, exceeding the strongest evaluated MLLM and conventional detector baselines by 14.7 and 11.5 points, respectively. It also outperforms ARGUS by 20.2 points on average and by 3.6 balanced-accuracy points on FaceVid's 20 unseen generators.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Antiphony 框架做深伪视频检测：以真实视频为共享参考，对四个视觉专家的打分做校准融合并控制误报，再让工具调用的多模态调查器只在接近校准阈值的样本上补充判断，并用反事实专家输出训练该调查器。
AI.relevance_reason: 「仅在阈值附近触发调查器」是一种按不确定性分配视觉证据获取的机制，可能为 LVR 的 LOOK/STOP 决策与视觉证据筛选提供线索；其用反事实专家输出训练对不可靠证据的鲁棒性，可供核查 latent 证据的贡献分配与融合。
